column1: # The L4 scenario registry (Story 12.12 D-c): one row per scenario of
# D-d and D-e. test-runner/l4/report.py fails the run when a row of a
# profile that ran has no L4-SCENARIO line, more than one, or FAIL.
#   name      <story>-<kind>-<slug>, kind iv<n>, ac<n>, x or matrix
#   source    the IV or AC the scenario proves; for a not-e2e row, the
#             test that proves its matrix rows instead
#   story     the story whose IV or AC it is
#   profiles  comma-separated profiles it runs in (one line expected per
#             profile that ran); `-` for a not-e2e row
#   level     full (PASS expected), partial (PASS or PARTIAL), not-e2e
#   lot       the Story 12.12 Lot that delivers it
#   state     pending until that Lot lands, then live; a pending row that
#             prints a line fails the report until it is marked live
#   matrix    `;`-separated Feature cells of the PRD coverage matrix it
# Profiles: streams and streams-single run in l4/run-l4.sh; the others
# are run.sh phases, each announced by an `L4-PROFILE <name>` line. suite
# is the whole run (12.8 IV3), announced by nobody yet; geoip is a compose
# profile run.sh does not run yet. Both are Lot H's.
